page.meta_description: Juliet is the Capulet daughter whose balcony scene, secret marriage, and dagger in the tomb make her the other half of the play's title. Related pages:…
page.content:
Capulet who loves Romeo and wakes to find him dead.

How Juliet connects

  • Work: Romeo and Juliet — Juliet is the Capulet lover of Romeo and Juliet.
  • Character: Romeo — Romeo and Juliet are the secret married lovers of the play.

What is Juliet?

Juliet is the Capulet daughter whose balcony scene, secret marriage, and dagger in the tomb make her the other half of the play's title.

Key threads lead to Romeo and Juliet and Romeo.
